title: A treatment plant expanded in stages, each finished before the next
heading: The Incremental Form Fills Segments in Order, With a Binary for Each Full One
cases: a second stage under way after a finished first is allowed, and one started beside a barely begun first is refused
a third stage started with the second not begun is refused, and all three under way in order is allowed
a first stage more than one unit along but not finished, with the second started, is refused
